identification: Mixed box: 4 Agatha Christie 'Crime Collection' omnibus hardbacks (3 novels per volume, black boards, red/orange page edges, 1960s-70s style), a vintage Caley Cranford chocolates round tin (Norwich, c.1950s, with lid), an 'Ideal' sewing tin with cotton reels and notions, a tin of buttons, a deck/box of playing cards (Blue Boy print), an empty gilt photo frame with oval mount, and a pressed glass sauce jug. Low value mixed lot.

viewing_check: Nothing book-wise of value. Check the Cranford tin for dents and the lid; the Ideal tin for wooden (not plastic) reels; the playing cards for any sealed or advertising packs. The four Christie volumes should say Lansdowne Press / Agatha Christie Ltd on the title page.
